assessment.implemented_scope: Managed detached runs now expose start/status/wait/resume, stable run IDs, PID-birth liveness, and source-bound safe resume for future runs. Ordinary check-status also diagnoses a stale legacy checkpoint without mutating it.
assessment.proposed_disposition: Keep deferred, but narrow/split the request: close the future managed-run portion as implemented; retain a legacy-checkpoint migration/recovery-planner request that reports the next journaled stage and exact safe command without weakening liveness or source checks.
assessment.remaining_gap: The pinned legacy result has no verifiable controller/child identity, so current check-status reports liveness_unknown and resumable=false. It does not convert the checkpoint to an interrupted snapshot or print first_safe_stage/an exact supported recovery command, even though the retained journal shows defect_lint was next and the historical --resume succeeded.
